examples.question_text:
Use constant difference to calculate:
(a) $6008-2986$
(b) $4000-1768$ by subtracting $1$ from both numbers.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Add $14$ to both numbers.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}6008-2986\\&=6022-3000\\&=3022\end{aligned}$
(b) Subtract $1$ from both numbers.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}4000-1768\\&=3999-1767\\&=2232\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: Use addition for subtraction to calculate $4013-3876$.

Use a nearby round number, then adjust, to calculate:
(a) $2476+998$
(b) $7000-8$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Add $1000$, then take back the extra $2$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}2476+998\\&=2476+1000-2\\&=3474\end{aligned}$
(b) Subtract $10$, then add back the extra $2$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}7000-8\\&=7000-10+2\\&=6992\end{aligned}$
